ceiling_policy: A ceiling is a statement about one artifact built by one cross toolchain, and the toolchain it was taken with is named in each row's budget.measured.comment. `text_bytes` is the summed .text of every emitted translation unit; `state_bytes` is sizeof(<Model>State) for the target ABI; both are bytes. Ceilings are fall-only in spirit: when size work lands, lower the ceiling in the same change that lands the saving, so the saving cannot be quietly spent again. Raising a ceiling is not forbidden but is never routine, and needs a reviewed justification recorded in the row's comment saying what grew and why the growth is worth the flash. The initial ceilings sit about four percent above the measurement recorded beside them: real headroom for ordinary churn, still tight enough that a five percent regression is red.
fp_ops_policy: `fp_ops` is the number of single-precision floating-point arithmetic instructions in a row's compiled objects, read from `arm-none-eabi-objdump -d` and summed over every emitted translation unit. It counts work, not traffic: the products and fused products, the sums, and the divide and square root. Moves, loads, stores, compares, conversions, sign flips, selections and roundings are excluded. The exact counted set has one owner, the gate's `fp_ops` module, and a single-precision mnemonic in neither its counted nor its excluded list fails the row rather than being counted as free. Bytes say whether the artifact fits; this number is what says whether the step makes its rate on a 600 MHz Cortex-M7 against a 1 ms period, so it is fall-only in the same sense as the size ceilings and for a sharper reason: when contraction work lands, these ceilings come down severalfold in the same change, and a later lowering that reintroduces quartic arithmetic is then red here instead of on the vehicle. The initial ceilings sit about four percent above the measurement recorded beside them.

entries.why: The artifact that flies: the RDD2 navigation estimator as GALEC-derived embedded C, linked into the Zephyr image on the vehicle's microcontroller. Its flash footprint and its single static allocation are acceptance criteria for that deployment, not diagnostics.

measured.comment: Re-measured 2026-08-23 after overlay bound equalization landed, with gcc-arm-embedded-15.2.rel1 under arm-none-eabi-gcc -Os -std=c99 -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -ffunction-sections -c over both emitted translation units. Both size numbers ROSE and the ceilings stand where they were, so the headroom this row carries is now smaller: state 31980 B, up 556 B (1.8%) from 31424 B, and text 59384 B, up 292 B (0.5%) from 59092 B. The cause is a layout decision, not new work. An overlay group is a union, so two regions' slots can start at one offset holding arrays of different lengths; a C compiler that value-numbers two same-address pointers together keeps one access path and reads the object size off it, and where the surviving path is the shorter array and the address is handed to a longer declared parameter bound, it reports a read past the end of an object that no execution performs. The layout pass declares every array sharing such a call-boundary address long enough for the bound that address is handed to, except where that array's own address is handed to a shorter bound, which stays as the block declared it (the wider rule was tried and reintroduced a report at SO3_Quat_product); both reports are gone on both cross targets and under the strict host preflight, measured. Only leading extents move, so no element changes address; the text growth is the shifted member offsets re-encoding in load and store immediates. fp_ops 1144 is unchanged, and the whole single-precision instruction MIX is identical mnemonic for mnemonic before and after, which is the expected shape of a change that moves no arithmetic. Outputs are identical: an ASan+UBSan differential over a 240-call multi-config dostep schedule with interleaved recalibrate digests every declared output after every call to 0xa42f1c5d395ecec7 on both emissions, with no sanitizer report on either. The 1184 fp ceiling predates the 1144 measurement and is deliberately left where it is.

entries.why: The same estimator inside its eFMU Production Code container, the form the certification review reads. Its C bodies come from the same shared templates as the embedded-c-galec row, so the two rows are pinned to the same numbers on purpose: a divergence between them means the packaging track changed what gets compiled rather than only how it is wrapped, which is a finding either way.

measured.comment: Re-measured 2026-08-23 after overlay bound equalization landed, with gcc-arm-embedded-15.2.rel1 under the same flags as the embedded-c-galec row, over ProductionCode/. Byte-identical to that row's measurement by construction: galec-production extends the same C templates and overrides only the conformance banner, which is a comment. It therefore carries that row's ceilings unchanged rather than its own four-percent band, so the two artifacts cannot drift apart without one of them going red.

entries.why: The heaviest matrix-algebra model with an established eFMI target, and nearly as large as the navigation estimator despite being a smaller model: sigma-point work is where an unrolled kernel or a widened scratch region shows up first, so this row is the early warning for both ceilings.

measured.comment: Re-measured 2026-08-23 after overlay bound equalization landed, with gcc-arm-embedded-15.2.rel1 under the same flags as the NavigationEstimator rows. state 31292 B, up 56 B (0.2%) from 31236 B, and text 56962 B, up 82 B (0.1%) from 56880 B; the ceilings stand. This row keeps earning its place by moving differently from the NavigationEstimator rows under the same change: the equalization costs it a tenth of what it costs them, because its regions' first members are already the wide sigma-point matrices, so most of the widening it does is absorbed by a union that was that size anyway. fp_ops 1322 is unchanged and the single-precision instruction mix is identical mnemonic for mnemonic. Outputs are identical: the same ASan+UBSan 240-call multi-config differential digests every declared output to 0xe4c41840b2631740 on both emissions, with no sanitizer report on either.

entries.why: The other artifact that flies, and the one on the fast loop: the RDD2 attitude and rate controller as GALEC-derived embedded C, running beside the navigation estimator on the same microcontroller and against a shorter period. It is gated from the day its cross-compile is warning-free on both targets, because a controller that fits only when the estimator happens to be small is not a deployment anyone can plan; its own ceilings say so independently. It is also the corpus's densest user of the Lie-group function library, so a region overlay or a call-boundary decision that regresses on nested small functions shows up here before it shows up on the estimators.

measured.comment: Measured 2026-08-23, the first measurement this artifact carries, with gcc-arm-embedded-15.2.rel1 under arm-none-eabi-gcc -Os -std=c99 -mcpu=cortex-m7 -mfpu=fpv5-d16 -mfloat-abi=hard -ffunction-sections -c over both emitted translation units. text 19788 B = 19620 B model + 168 B shared kernels; state 3860 B (struct ControllerState), of which 3136 B is checked working-memory slot storage across six overlay groups. Ceilings are +4.0% on each. The row could not exist before this date: the cross compile reported two -Wstringop-overread false positives, proven false by a sanitizer differential and by hand against the Lie-group math, and a budget row taken from an artifact its own toolchain warns about would have certified the warning along with the numbers. Both are retired by overlay bound equalization, which cost this artifact 40 B of state and 16 B of text against the pre-pass emission (3820 B and 19772 B): the union absorbs most of the widening, and what survives is one group's largest region growing. fp_ops 336 is what the pass does NOT touch, and the single-precision instruction mix is identical mnemonic for mnemonic before and after. Outputs are identical: an ASan+UBSan differential over a 240-call multi-config dostep schedule with interleaved recalibrate digests every declared output after every call to 0x22e160245e3afbfe on both emissions, every value finite, with no sanitizer report on either. The artifact also passes the strict host assurance preflight (-O2 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wundef -Wcast-qual -Wstrict-prototypes -Wmissing-prototypes) with -Werror.
